en: Black‑and‑white view of a central town square with a prominent three‑storey stone building bearing a clock‑tower and small spire. The façade carries the inscription "KOENIGLICHES AMTSGERICHT" (Royal District Court). In front stand leafless, pollarded trees and a decorative street lamp. To the right are adjoining townhouses with shopfronts and signage, including one marked "Hôtel Altenburg". The scene is quiet with no visible people or vehicles, suggesting an early 20th‑century European townscape.
